status: Retained shared-query physics synchronization; F8 open
change: Read candidate physics components through one shared ECS query view instead of resolving identity and acquiring separate component borrows for every field of every candidate. View ends before ECS ownership changes; no view is built for an empty candidate set.
contract: Same candidate ordering, nested-body resolution, affine validation, activity and removal handling. Uses the existing internal query API; no new public API, cache authority, unsafe code or gameplay simplification.

focused.scope: Mac release; 5000 moving/rotating unparented colliders; 20 warmup and 60 measured syncs; propagation outside timer

native.scope: Mac native-only dense-5000; no rendering/Dart/catch-up; 40 warmup and 300 measured ticks per mode

validation.clippy: release, all targets, warnings denied: passed
validation.iosRelease: built, installed and live verification completed; exact PID stopped
validation.regression: Mixed physics/nonphysics membership changes, activity filtering, missing/restored WorldTransform, despawn/replacement, collider placement and subsequent empty sync; existing nested-body and invalid-affine regressions also pass.

limitations: Short sequential phone diagnostics are not sustained FPS qualification.
Phone CPU/GPU numbers are medians of per-frame window p50s; not per-tick timings and medians are not additive.
Native benchmark compares profiling on/off outcomes within each run, not cross-build state equivalence.
Mac CPU improvement does not imply the same percentage increase in displayed FPS.
